title: OpenEPCIS Link Type Vocabulary
description:
GS1 Digital Link link types minted by OpenEPCIS under
https://ref.openepcis.io/voc/. The GS1 Web Vocabulary is the primary home of
link types; a term lives here only for a link relation GS1 has not yet
ratified, follows the GS1 link-type pattern verbatim, and records how it
migrates to the GS1 term once one exists.

properties.label: Asset Administration Shell for this item
properties.comment: A link to the Asset Administration Shell (IEC 63278) representation of the identified item — the AAS environment the OpenEPCIS AAS service derives from GS1 Web Vocabulary master data, built from the IDTA submodel templates mirrored in extensions/upstream/idta-aas/.
